children: Volato Group entered into two related financing agreements with DFU: a Common Stock Purchase Agreement providing an equity line of up to $1.0 billion and a Registration Rights Agreement to enable resales. The ELOC allows Volato, at its discretion, to sell shares over 36 months following effectiveness of a resale registration, with up to two daily puts totaling $6 million and pricing tied to market levels subject to a $0.21 floor and a 4.99% ownership cap. The company will issue commitment shares and Series B preferred stock (convertible upon approvals) as consideration. The Registration Rights Agreement requires Volato to file a resale registration statement by November 22, 2026, and pursue effectiveness promptly.
Agreement 1: Volato Group Secures Up to $1 Billion Equity Line With DFU to Bolster Liquidity
: Equity line of credit (Common Stock Purchase Agreement)
: Enhance liquidity through flexible equity financing
Agreement 2: Volato Group Grants DFU Registration Rights for ELOC and Series B Preferred Resales
: Registration Rights Agreement for resale of ELOC and preferred conversion shares
: Facilitate resale of shares issued under ELOC
